name: Image with note
description: A large image on the left, a title and a paragraph on the right. A text-only slide would lose the persuasive force of the picture itself.

photo.hint: a 4:3 or 16:9 photo or figure, cropped with cover; may carry hotspots (click-to-jump areas during playback)

caption.hint: 1 to 3 lines of explanation or source
